Conrol Panels: 
After designing any new Operator Control Panels (Screens) they must be added to the Control Panels list (here) in order to be applied to either: Workcenter Group or Workcenter.

If defined at the Workcenter, the Workcenter Group Control Panel will be overridden. All products/processes will utilize a single Control Panel - based upon the workcenter where work is being performed.
